PDF Studio ("we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy.

1. INFORMATION WE COLLECT
We do NOT collect, store, or share personal information. All documents and photos are processed 100% offline on your device.

2. FILE ACCESS
The app requests storage permission solely to read images/PDFs you select and save generated files. We never upload, scan, or share your files.

3. THIRD-PARTY ADS
This app uses Google AdMob to display ads, which may collect anonymous data (like your advertising ID) for personalization. Learn more: https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites

4. DATA SECURITY
All data stays on your device. If you uninstall, generated files in the app folder are deleted.

5. CHILDREN
Our app does not knowingly collect info from children under 13.

6. CONTACT
Questions? Email: cartoniq.business@gmail.com

By using PDF Studio, you agree to this Privacy Policy.
